challenge.name: The Summer Forecast Gap
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has skewed demand for seasonal goods, exposing that our KPI definitions do not account for weather driven spikes. #model_monica# wants to automate the KPI tracking to capture these shifts in real time, while #efficiency_emilia# prefers to keep the process manual to ensure every metric aligns with the broader business strategy. #efficiency_emilia# might accept an automated solution if it clearly supports the agreed business goals.

output.content: The heatwave broke our seasonal demand assumptions, and our current KPI definitions are too slow to reflect that reality. I want the KPI definition and its downstream hand overs to data ingestion fully automated so we capture these weather driven shifts in real time. Right now, the manual review cycle means we are always looking at last week's numbers while the shelves empty. Automating this pipeline is the only way to keep our monitoring aligned with actual store performance. The more immediate and granular the signal, the better our models can adapt to sudden spikes in seasonal goods. I am asking for a system that updates the metrics continuously, not one that waits for a human to verify the spreadsheet before the next training run.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that more immediate and granular signals make the models better, indicating that exceeding the basic request for automation with higher-frequency updates would increase satisfaction.
